name: Cornea Confidential
tagline: Corneal Disease and External Eye for the Optometrist
description: A 15-episode series on corneal pathology — keratoconus, dystrophies, infections, and the slit lamp and topography signs that guide management.

episodes.title: Corneal Anatomy and the Five Layers (Now Six with Dua's Layer)
episodes.description: The corneal layers and their clinical relevance, the epithelial barrier, Bowman's scar formation, and endothelial pump function.

episodes.title: Keratoconus: Early Detection with Topography and Tomography
episodes.description: The topographic signs of subclinical keratoconus (inferior steepening, asymmetric bowtie), the Belin-Ambrosio display, and the Amsler-Krumeich stages.

episodes.title: Corneal Topography Interpretation: Axial, Tangential, and Refractive Maps
episodes.description: How to read a topography map, the normal patterns (round, oval, symmetric bowtie), and the abnormal patterns that signal pathology.

episodes.title: Corneal Collagen Cross-Linking: Indications, Protocol, and Outcomes
episodes.description: When CXL is indicated (progressive keratoconus), the Dresden protocol vs transepithelial, and the expected outcome and complications.

episodes.title: Fuchs Endothelial Dystrophy: Guttae, Edema, and the DSAEK/DMEK Decision
episodes.description: Identifying cornea guttata, monitoring pachymetry and acuity, and when endothelial keratoplasty (DSAEK, DMEK) is indicated.

episodes.title: Dry Eye Disease and the Ocular Surface: TFOS DEWS II Framework
episodes.description: The DEWS II definition and classification, the two main mechanisms (aqueous deficient, evaporative), and the stepwise management algorithm.

episodes.title: Corneal Abrasions and Foreign Bodies: Management and Tetanus Status
episodes.description: Assessing the depth and location of an abrasion, rust ring removal, the role of antibiotics and patching, and when to refer for deep FB.

episodes.title: Bacterial Keratitis: Risk Factors, Organisms, and Empiric Antibiotics
episodes.description: The contact lens keratitis presentation, identifying the ulcer depth, choosing fortified antibiotics vs fluoroquinolone monotherapy.

episodes.title: Herpes Simplex Keratitis: Epithelial, Stromal, and Endothelial Forms
episodes.description: The dendritic ulcer and the role of topical antivirals, disciform stromal keratitis and the cautious use of steroids, and endotheliitis.

episodes.title: Herpes Zoster Ophthalmicus: Hutchinson Sign and the Ocular Complications
episodes.description: When the nasociliary nerve is involved (Hutchinson sign), the timeline of ocular complications, and systemic antiviral urgency within 72 hours.

episodes.title: Acanthamoeba and Fungal Keratitis: The Contact Lens Nightmare
episodes.description: The ring infiltrate of Acanthamoeba, the delay in diagnosis, and the importance of taking a thorough contact lens exposure history.

episodes.title: Marginal Keratitis and Sterile Infiltrates: The Immune Edge
episodes.description: Distinguishing sterile marginal infiltrates from infectious ulcers, the role of staphylococcal hypersensitivity, and the topical steroid indication.

episodes.title: Pterygium and Pinguecula: When to Excise and How to Prevent Recurrence
episodes.description: The indications for pterygium excision (visual axis, induced astigmatism, chronic inflammation), conjunctival autograft, and recurrence rates.

episodes.title: Salzmann Nodular Degeneration and Peripheral Corneal Thinning
episodes.description: Recognising Salzmann nodules, the systemic workup for peripheral ulcerative keratitis (RA, Wegener), and the urgent referral for melt.

episodes.title: Corneal Transplant Types: PK, DSAEK, DMEK, and DALK — Co-Management Pearls
episodes.description: The indications for each graft type, the post-op optometric schedule, suture removal timing, and recognising rejection.
